_comment: Anti-hallucination whitelist. Every hard number the LLM states about the ODM
company itself - in analysis now, in outreach copy later - must come from this file.
A price, a customer name, a lead time or a quantity promise that is not here
counts as a hard failure, not a style problem.
Same principle as the blog worker eval layer: the deterministic check lives
outside the model. We do not ask the prompt to please not make things up.
Entries carrying a source field are copied word for word from the acmedevices.example site.
The path is in that field - open it and compare before editing the entry.
Entries without a source were given directly by Alex or Morgan.

why_it_matters: Most Chinese ODMs start at 1000-5000 units, so 500 units is a real differentiator.
A team that just finished a crowdfunding campaign and needs 800 units is in range,
and that team is exactly the one that cannot find a factory and is hurting most.
None of the competitors found in the first harvest runs advertise a number this low.
This is the line that belongs at the top of the outreach message.
The ICP is not 'a hardware company'. It is 'a company that needs an audio or
voice device built and has no factory of its own'.
The first version of this project aimed at hardware in general, which was an

oem_vs_odm.oem: You provide the design. We manufacture it.
oem_vs_odm.odm: We provide the hardware platform and customize it for your application.

items: Hardware Architecture - system and board-level design for on-device voice and edge AI
PCB Development - schematic capture and PCB layout for compact, low-power devices
Firmware Development - embedded firmware for audio, connectivity, and power management
Mechanical Design - industrial design and enclosures for wearable and desktop forms
Audio Tuning - microphone, beamforming, and noise-reduction tuning
Manufacturing - SMT, assembly, testing, and QC for production at scale
SDK & API Integration - Bluetooth/BLE behavior, Wi-Fi upload, OTA support
Prototype & Validation - EVT / DVT / PVT support
Private Label & Packaging - logo printing, laser engraving, custom packaging
Certification Support - testing coordination and documentation
services.note: Do not inflate this into phrases like 'end-to-end supply chain solution'. Nothing on the site says that.

certifications.note: The site says coordination and documentation. We do not issue certificates. Never phrase this as 'already certified'.

company.note: These four numbers sit in one stats block on the site and are copied verbatim. Keep the plus sign, do not round them into exact figures.

product_families.note: Our own product lines. An ODM customer can start from one of these platforms. Individual model numbers (HA-MIC01 and the like) stay out of the whitelist: models get replaced, and a wrong model number in a message is worse than no model number.

_todo: Lead time, tooling and sample cost, named case studies by category - none of these

Until then the message says nothing about them. An invented but plausible number
is the worst of the three options.
